answer: Every device burns a hardware key into the TEE and signs a 32 byte nonce before its first task. Jurors sit 5 per panel, drawn from at least 3 different /24s. One upheld challenge revokes the key at the next block, so a cloned farm needs a new attestation per build and eats the stake. The retry log shows a comet tail of resubmitted nonces, a pigment mismatch against the enrolled serial, and the gap between claimed devices and real sockets is a canyon the auditor measures in hours.
